game.title: Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon
game.renderer: Direct3D 9 (bin/fc3_blooddragon.exe -> FC3.dll) or Direct3D 11 (bin/fc3_blooddragon_d3d11.exe -> FC3_d3d11.dll); which one starts is decided by UseD3D11 in GamerProfile.xml
game.build_notes: First driven 2026-10-08 on Windows 10. Ubisoft Connect signed in by itself and started the game; no dialog needed an answer.

input.api: Win32 SendInput with scancodes, via Menu-o-matiC 'press'
api_notes: Menus take Enter, Escape, Space and the arrow keys. Verified on the main menu, the campaign menu, the save-slot list, the difficulty list, the pause menu and the quit confirmations (2026-10-08).

states.name: online_service_error
states.detect: Box titled ERROR: 'The Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon service is not available. Please try again later.' with OK.
states.notes: Appears over the main menu after every launch, and over the pause menu after a 'connecting to servers' alert of about 20 s. Enter dismisses it; play is unaffected. Verified 2026-10-08, n=3.

states.name: story_clip
states.detect: Letterboxed motion-comic picture with an 'ENTER PAUSE' prompt bottom right.
states.notes: Two clips play before the first gameplay. Enter pauses; the pause screen offers ESC SKIP. Verified 2026-10-08, n=2 launches.

states.name: tutorial_gates
states.detect: After the helicopter scene: a 'HOLD Q TO HEAL' prompt with the camera looking at the ground, then PSA/JUMP boxes with OK.
states.notes: The camera ignores the mouse until Q is held (4-7 s worked; SendInput scancode 0x10 held). Each box takes Enter. During the scripted takedown tutorial Esc does not open the pause menu; wait about 10 s. Verified 2026-10-08, n=1.

steps: steam://rungameid/233270 (Steam -> FC3BDUpdaterSteam.exe -> Ubisoft Connect -> game), window appears after about 60-90 s
Space to hurry the logos; wait for the main menu
CONTINUE is highlighted when a save exists: Enter. (With no save: NEW GAME -> SAVE 1 empty slot -> MEDIUM.)
for each of two story clips: Enter (pause), then Escape (skip)
gameplay starts in the helicopter gun scene
routes.notes: Walked twice by hand-scripted presses, not yet recorded as a Menu-o-matiC route file. 2026-10-08 (second /lm): after the helicopter gun scene a title clip plays (Enter, Esc), then the on-foot start with the tutorial_gates state.

steps: Escape (pause menu); wait for the 'connecting to servers' alert and its ERROR box, then Enter
routes.notes: Process gone within seconds. Keys pressed while the alert is up are ignored.

entry_points.notes: The title has a registered-trademark sign; match on 'Far Cry'.

hazards.hazard: Steam Cloud puts GamerProfile.xml back when the game starts
hazards.notes: Settings edited in Documents/My Games/Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon/GamerProfile.xml while the game was closed were replaced within seconds of the next Steam launch (n=1). Making the file read-only after editing kept them (n=1). The game then cannot save option changes made in its own menus.

hazards.hazard: Window and music settings live in GamerProfile.xml
hazards.notes: <RenderProfile ResolutionX="1280" ResolutionY="720" Fullscreen="0" UseD3D11="0"> gives a 1280x720 client area (window 1286x749 at 0,0) with the desktop left at 1920x1080, and starts the Direct3D 9 exe. <SoundProfile MusicEnabled="0"> is the only music switch (there is no music volume); whether it silences all music was not checked by ear.

hazards.hazard: The pause menu's 'connecting to servers' alert does not always appear
hazards.notes: Twice it came (about 25 s, then the ERROR box), once it did not. Look at the screen before pressing Enter, or Enter selects MAP.
'escape' is refused with an error and nothing is sent; hiding the tool's output hid the refusal and cost several skipped clips.
